purpose: Local read contract for the 123 catalogued raw health observations.

supported_relations.metric_points: all catalogued raw observations, one row per persisted point
supported_relations.completed_night_sleep: main_night.* fields with original algorithm_version; available_at is null because this table has no verified availability clock
supported_relations.workouts: workout.* mapped columns; received_at is available_at, source_snapshot_at stays metadata
supported_relations.energy_snapshots: energy_snapshot.* mapped columns; computed_at is available_at
supported_relations.target_snapshots: target.* fields plus catalogued sub_score.target_kind target IDs when present; computed_at is available_at

omitted_relations.feature_snapshots: feature JSON payload has no verified per-field catalog binding
omitted_relations.naive_baselines: no verified catalog field contract for the persisted baseline rows

lookup: SELECT observation_id, value, units, original_date, source FROM <profile_schema>.health_observation_v1 WHERE observation_id = $1 ORDER BY original_date, source

fields.value: nullable numeric metric_points.qty; JSON number or null
fields.original_date: exact metric_points.date text including offset/precision; no timezone coercion
fields.catalog_units: resolved permitted unit labels from XML/iOS/sleep declarations, or ['unknown']
fields.catalog_grain: iOS declared sample_start/hour_sum/event_start/stage_start/wake_date when available, otherwise inventory default

isolation: The security_invoker view is created in each profile schema; distinct profile logins can read their own schema but cannot read another profile schema.
aggregation: none; callers must choose a separate versioned reduction contract.
